diagnostic_conclusion.primary_verdict: B) Probable Systematic Real-World False-Positive / Domain-Gap Problem
diagnostic_conclusion.justification: Across 25 diverse real-world authentic non-benchmark videos, LipForensics produced a 44.0% False Positive Rate at threshold 0.50 (median score 0.3912, mean 0.5189). 5/25 (20.0%) of genuinely authentic videos scored >= 0.90 fake probability, confirming that the primary failure on videoplayback.mp4 (p=0.9913) is NOT an isolated glitch, but represents a systematic architectural domain gap between FaceForensics++ c23 studio training footage and real-world in-the-wild web/mobile video.
